# indie-market-analyst

> Open-source, tool-first, swarm-orchestrated AI research analyst for Indian markets (NSE/BSE). Free data sources, OpenRouter models, deterministic backtester.

This project builds a hallucination-resistant analyst for the Indian stock market. Multiple specialist agents (collector, verifier, calculator, writer) coordinate via the OpenAI Agents SDK; every inter-agent handoff carries a strict Pydantic schema, and an output guardrail rejects free-floating numeric claims that weren't produced by a tool call.

## Key facts

- Repository: https://github.com/dharunashokkumar/indie-market-analyst
- License: MIT
- Language: Python 3.12+ (backend), React + TypeScript (frontend)
- LLM provider: OpenRouter (free tier by default)
- Data: yfinance, MCX India via mcxlib, NSE/BSE public endpoints, Google Finance scrape — all free
- Backtest engine: pure pandas/numpy with Indian cost model (STT, stamp duty, brokerage)
